intro: With the ectoplasm in hand, Mux Manascrambler needs a stable, portable source of energy to keep it active. He has heard rumours of Magma Lord Bokk, an elemental in the Burning Steppes whose heart is a Magma Core, and wants that core brought to him in Gadgetzan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Next we shall need to find a stable and portable source of energy to keep the ectoplasm active. I've heard rumors of a mighty elemental called Magma Lord Bokk, whose heart is a powerful magma core - an endless supply of heat!
It's said he can be found in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain. Bring the magma core to me and we shall have enough juice to power the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the Magma Lord, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done it! This will certainly provide enough energy to power up the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
